people.name: Azmon
people.line: Place on the southern border of Judah.

people.name: Brook_of_Egypt
people.line: Southwestern boundary of the Promised Land

translations.web: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.
translations.bsb: It proceeded to Azmon, joined the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the Sea. This was their southern border.
translations.kjv: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
translations.asv: and it passed along to Azmon, and went out at the brook of Egypt; and the goings out of the border were at the sea: this shall be your south border.
